title: gwsource: code and analysis scripts for "Where does it come from and where does it go? Open-source flow tracing for MODFLOW 6 models"
description: Archive of the paper branch of gwsource, cell-mixing flow tracing for MODFLOW 6. It holds the gwsource package and the scripts in studies/ that rerun every study of the paper and draw every figure. studies/README.md explains how: create the pinned environment of studies/environment.yml, then run python studies/setup_tools.py and python studies/reproduce.py.
